description: Defines a finite-state machine (FSM) for managing uplink processing in a radio system, including state transitions, PDU handling, and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: uplink_processor_fsm
classes.description: Implements a finite-state machine to control uplink PDU processing, including state transitions, request handling, and synchronization.

classes.name: uplink_processor_fsm_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the FSM about PDU count changes and acceptance status.

methods.name: start_new_slot
methods.description: Initiates a new slot for uplink processing, transitioning the FSM to accepting PDUs if possible.

methods.name: has_receive_request
methods.description: Checks if the processor has receive requests for a specific slot.

methods.name: stop_accepting_pdu
methods.description: Notifies the FSM to stop accepting new PDUs.

methods.name: increment_pending_pdu_count
methods.description: Increments the count of pending PDUs, indicating a new PDU is being processed.

methods.name: start_discard_slot
methods.description: Begins discarding a slot, transitioning the FSM to a locked state if conditions are met.

methods.name: finish_discard_slot
methods.description: Completes slot discarding, returning the FSM to idle state.

methods.name: start_handle_rx_symbol
methods.description: Begins handling a receive symbol, locking the FSM for processing.

methods.name: finish_handle_rx_symbol
methods.description: Completes handling a receive symbol, unlocking the FSM.

methods.name: on_create_pdu_task
methods.description: Creates a new asynchronous PDU processing task if the FSM state allows.

methods.name: on_finish_processing_pdu
methods.description: Marks completion of a PDU processing, decrementing the pending count.

methods.name: on_prach_detection
methods.description: Requests a PRACH detection task, incrementing the PRACH counter if allowed.

methods.name: on_end_prach_detection
methods.description: Marks completion of a PRACH detection task, decrementing the PRACH counter.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the FSM, waiting for all asynchronous tasks and PRACH detections to complete.
